newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends down on downward adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends down on downward adjustment.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka slipped further at the close to 42.5300/42.5450 against dollar in interbank trading after opening lower at 42.4900/42.5400 as a result of downward adjustment by the central bank on Monday.
The taka was adjusted downwards at 42.35/55 from 42.20/40 previously. The taka was quoted at 42.3750/42.3850 at the close of Sunday's trading.

Dealers said the central bank move was anticipated and the market was mostly active on a moderate demand for dollars from importers. The interbank call money rates closed steady at 4.0 percent to 5.0 percent.
